additional_info.subject: ID0401452-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / S2 170003311] ocppConnectionLost CRM:00439000728
additional_info.body:
Hello:
PLease check also:
Basic information:
The -XF3 router ("Router 1") is used to communicate with the SCB and is on the right side
when the door is open. This router is factory-equipped with an M2M SIM card. The router
uses this SIM card to establish a mobile network connection to the Internet (only valid for EU,
CH, NO, UK; consumer SIM cards must be used in other countries). This SIM card is the
property of the manufacturer. After the final decommissioning of the charging station, the
operator must remove the SIM card and return it to Siemens AG.
The router -XF4 ("Router 2") is intended for the Internet connection to the OCPP backend of
the operator and the credit card terminal. This router is located on the left side when the door
is open. The router is configured by default to connect to the Internet via Ethernet. To do this,
connect a network cable to the WAN port
(-FA6) in the connection area of the charging
station.
so in the router it show that the Wired connection didnt get a IP yet
So no connection to the Internet this is a basic connection like everyone has at home and can be troubleshoot in the same way. Please check if the connection to router is still available check what the LED on WAN side is showing. From HQ side there is not much we can do, since its a local connection. Please also check the cable connection and the ports on the lower side.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Semih Sentuerk
Siemens eMobility Technical Support Team
